notes:
## New features & enhancements

- "Turn the radio off until the next slot" now means any stretch with nothing scheduled - a gap between two slots as much as the end of the day.
- The next-up chip says "Radio off" for a gap that will go quiet, and names the station the schedule comes back with.

## Bug fixes

- A gap between two slots ignored that setting and carried on playing.
- A slot ending into a gap faded the level out and straight back in on the same station, for no change at all.
- The Schedule pane promised the switch covered gaps in one paragraph and denied it in the next.
